Offscreen→synthetic near replay asserts no extra call, next actual8s frame retains phase, following.125s advances exactly.125. Light disposes/remounts a saved stopped journey; firstactual8s visual call retains phase, next.125 advances exactly.125. Continue retains independent active head looking while zeroing precommand journey elapsed; stopped realframes receive exactly one visual call.
